caption_en: How do you say this Hebrew word in English? Public diplomacy, explaining Israel, advocacy.
caption_he:
איך אומרים הסברה באנגלית? 3 דרכים 🇮🇱

בכנס: Public diplomacy
עם חברים: Explaining Israel
בפאנל: Advocacy

המילה הסברה פשוט אומרת explaining. דיפלומטים ישראלים מעדיפים היום public diplomacy, כי explaining נשמע מתגונן.

אנגלית היא הדרך שבה הסיפור שלנו מגיע לעולם. שמרו את זה לפגישה הבאה.

מקור: Wikipedia, Public diplomacy of Israel (2026).

lines.line: Maya asks, what's our word for this in English? It's the word Israelis use all the time.
It literally means explaining. Israelis use it for telling Israel's side to the world, in English.
At a conference or with diplomats, say: public diplomacy.
With friends over coffee, say: explaining Israel.
On a panel or in an interview, say: advocacy.
Israeli diplomats today prefer public diplomacy. Explaining sounds defensive. Public diplomacy sounds like a plan.
Now a quick chat. Someone asks you: what do you do for Israel online?
Public diplomacy. I tell Israel's story in English. Every day.
English is how the story reaches the world. Not your Hebrew. Your English. One clear sentence at a time.
Save this for your next meeting, or your next panel.
